evidence.notes: Test.loadData reads a CSV static resource and inserts local SObject rows in test context.
Public Test.loadData overload accepts a Schema.SObjectType token and static resource name.
Public List<String> fixed-search overload supplies deterministic SOSL result ids.

source.content: @isTest private class TestHelperLoadDataFixedSearchEvidenceTest { @isTest static void loadDataAndFixedSearchUsePublicOverloads() { List<SObject> loaded = Test.loadData(Account.SObjectType, 'Accounts'); System.assertEquals(2, loaded.size()); System.assertNotEquals(null, loaded[0].Id); System.assertEquals('Acme', loaded[0].get('Name')); Account searchAccount = new Account(Name = 'Search Lodge'); insert searchAccount; Test.setFixedSearchResults(new List<String>{String.valueOf(searchAccount.Id)}); List<Account> rows = (List<Account>)([FIND 'Search*' IN NAME FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name)][0]); System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); System.assertEquals(searchAccount.Id, rows[0].Id); System.assertEquals(3, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account]); } }
